title: About Me
text: Let’s get started on who Having been raised in a beach town, my drive to conserve and protect the environment has been exemplified. This undying passion has led to my current trajectory of narrowing my studies to rivers and conservation planning. I love to be outdoors and I love, even more, finding new ways to mitigate human impacts on natural systems and ecological systems.

title: Michael Kjær Torbensen
text: Hey! My name is Michael Torbensen. I’m a fourth-year Environmental Science (BS) major at UC Santa Barbara that transferred over from Santa Barbara City College (SBCC) where I obtained by AS in Environmental Science. Click around if you’d like to get to know more about me!
